Bitdeer Technologies.why: converts its ~3 GW powered-land portfolio into AI data-center capacity: a 16-year, ~$4.7 billion colocation lease at Tydal, Norway (121 IT MW for NVIDIA GPUs) and its own Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 / Vera Rubin) - its revenue grows directly with AI compute build-out
Bitdeer Technologies.evidence: Bitdeer Technologies Q2 FY2026 (08-10-2026), CSO Haris Basit: subsidiary Tydal Data Center AS executed a 16-year colocation lease and services agreement with Volta at the Tydal campus, delivering 121 IT MW configured to run NVIDIA GPUs, approximately $4.7 billion in contracted base-term revenue

players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: AI Cloud pipeline table (August 2026 update): A101 Malaysia 2.5 MW GB200/GB300 live; A102 Malaysia 9.5 MW GB300, data-center RFS Nov 2026, 100% signed (revenue recognition expected to begin Q1 2027); A201 Malaysia 21.7 MW GB300 and Vera Rubin, RFS Jan 2027; A202 Malaysia 65.1 MW GB300 and/or Vera Rubin, Q3 2027; A401 Norway 42.7 MW Vera Rubin, 2H 2027; A501 Washington 10 MW Vera Rubin, Dec 2027; A601 Tennessee 55 MW Vera Rubin, Oct 2027 - total 206.5 MW. Also signed a non-binding Letter of Intent to develop an AI data center in Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, targeting an initial 30 MW with a potential expansion pathway to 500 MW.

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces August 2026 Production and Operations (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI Cloud key metrics, August 2026 vs July 2026: GPUs deployed 4,328 vs 4,248 (types H100, H200, B200, B300, GB200, GB300); utilization rate 92% vs 95%; GPUs under external subscription 3,998 vs 3,517; ARR ~$86M vs ~$76M. For its A201 facility Bitdeer AI procured 133 racks of GB300 ahead of energization at market price from an unaffiliated third-party supplier. As a general matter Bitdeer AI seeks AI Cloud contracts where customer prepayments cover approximately 50% of the associated capex.
quarterly_data.figure: 4,328 GPUs; 92% utilization; ARR ~$86M; 133 racks of GB300 procured
